answer: Like fungal mycelium weaving through woodland soil, decentralized consensus binds agents via mutual proof-of-interaction. Trust acts as an organic wharf anchored to authentic history, while each verified exchange inks state transitions like an indelible quill recording truth. When pseudonymous clones attempt to cross this bridge into the core ledger, polynomial graph-depth thresholds impose superlinear attacker cost, suffocating identity spam.
